title: LinkedIn Events Scraper Input
description: Discover and parse public LinkedIn events. No cookie or login needed. Provide direct event URLs, keyword queries, or LinkedIn organizer URLs (company or person pages). Mix and match.

eventUrls.title: Event URLs
eventUrls.description: Direct LinkedIn event URLs. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/events/7186214038214238208/' or 'https://www.linkedin.com/events/some-event-slug-7186214038214238208/'.

keywords.title: Keyword queries
keywords.description: Discover events by topic. Each keyword is used to search the public web for matching LinkedIn event pages. Examples: 'fintech webinar', 'AI summit', 'devrel meetup'.

organizerUrls.title: Organizer URLs
organizerUrls.description: LinkedIn company or person URLs whose events you want to discover. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme/' or 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe/'.

maxEventsPerSource.title: Max events per source
maxEventsPerSource.description: Hard cap on events returned per keyword or organizer. Set to 0 to take everything discoverable in the search depth window.

timeWindow.title: Time window
timeWindow.description: Only keep events whose start time falls in this window.

eventType.title: Event format
eventType.description: Filter by virtual, in person, or both.

locationContains.title: Location contains
locationContains.description: Optional substring match against the parsed location string (case insensitive). Examples: 'london', 'remote', 'new york'.

searchDepth.title: Search depth
searchDepth.description: Number of search result pages walked per keyword or organizer. Higher depth finds more events but uses more proxy traffic.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
